changes.old: The ACCC has prepared a questionnaire on the Acquisition. Submissions or information in response to the questionnaire should be provided by 31 August 2026 via email to mergers@accc.gov.au with the title Submission re: Novonesis – Microbiogen. The ACCC’s ability to give detailed consideration to submissions received after this time may be limited. Open date 24 Aug 2026 Closing date 31 Aug 2026
changes.new: The period for providing submissions or information in response to the ACCC’s questionnaire has concluded.
